name: _merge-verify warm-lane concurrency race: concurrent lane reseed/mutation causes "file vanished mid-run" failures during background integrity sweeps

task_definition.title: _merge-verify warm-lane concurrency race: concurrent lane reseed/mutation causes "file vanished mid-run" failures during background integrity sweeps
task_definition.description:
Recurring infra bug, distinct from any single task's code correctness. Task 5210's newly-added DF_VERIFY_ROLE=background main-tip integrity sweep hit the same failure signature TWICE against the shared `_merge-verify` warm lane at /home/leo/src/warm-lanes/worktrees/_merge-verify on 2026-07-14 (~16:36-16:38Z and again ~18:12-18:22Z, the second AFTER task 5210 had already landed on main at 6c88cfcd5c). In both incidents, files that were present and actively in use moments earlier (scripts/verify.sh, scripts/verify-pipeline-guard.sh, .cargo/run-with-occt.sh, Cargo.lock) became unreadable/missing mid-run, producing cascading exit-127 / nextest "[double-spawn] ... No such file or directory (os error 2)" / check-manifold-deps.sh "could not read manifold-csg-sys version from Cargo.lock" failures — none touching files in the task under test's own diff. Both were triaged by unblock-auto as risk_label=human-review-required under escalation esc-main-sweep-8eb24cf25f39-2.

Suspected root cause: a concurrent merge/land or lane-reclaim/reseed process violating the "one consumer per lane at a time; acquire_lane always re-seeds from base" warm-lane invariant (docs/prds/warm-lane-pool-cow-seeding.md §9.3/§9.5) — i.e. `_merge-verify`'s exclusivity guarantee is not actually enforced against a second concurrent acquirer, and/or the newly-added DF_VERIFY_ROLE=background main-tip sweep reads/acquires the lane without holding the same exclusivity lock the merge worker uses.

Investigate:
1. Run scripts/warm-lane-audit.sh for a RECLAIMABLE/LEAKED/PRESERVED-OK read on `_merge-verify`.
2. Correlate orchestrator/merge-queue logs and the background-sweep invocation schedule around 2026-07-14T16:36:05Z-16:38:17Z and 18:12:55Z-18:20:37Z to identify what else acquired/reseeded/wrote that lane concurrently with the verify run.
3. Once the second concurrent actor is identified, harden lane acquisition (locking/exclusivity check) so a concurrent acquire is refused or queued rather than silently mutating a lane mid-read by another consumer.

This is currently undermining the credibility of the new background main-tip integrity sweep (task 5210): unaddressed, repeat occurrences will misleadingly present as main-is-red and generate spurious escalations.
